```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load and format data

```{r load data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

pupFilter <- 7 # censor pups <=7 months old

raw <- readr::read_csv("../Data/PHOCAS_spotted_seal_diet.csv",na="-",col_types="ffcfcffifif")
intake <- raw %>% select(Seal,`Month-Year`,Facility, Season, Sex,`Age (years)`,`Age (months)`,`Age class`,`Mean Body Mass (kg)`,`Mean Food Intake (kcals)`,`Mass-specific food intake (kcal/kg)`,`Estimated data`) %>% 
# rename columns
          rename(seal = Seal, date = `Month-Year`, facility = Facility, season=Season, sex = Sex, ageYears = `Age (years)`, ageMonths = `Age (months)`, ageClass = `Age class`, mass = `Mean Body Mass (kg)`, intake = `Mean Food Intake (kcals)`, intakems = `Mass-specific food intake (kcal/kg)`, estInd = `Estimated data`) %>% 
# filter by facility
          filter(facility %in% c("ASLC","LML")) %>%
# filter by nonpup
          filter(ageClass!="pup") %>%
# remove NAs in response
          filter(!is.na(intake)) %>%
          filter(!is.na(intakems)) %>% 
# remove estimated data
          filter(estInd==0) %>%
# add month and year fields
          mutate(date=lubridate::fast_strptime(date, "%b-%y")) %>%
          mutate(year=lubridate::year(date)) %>%
          mutate(month=factor(months.Date(date,abbreviate=TRUE),levels=month.abb)) %>%
          mutate(monthNum=match(month,month.abb)-1) %>%
          mutate(yearNum=match(year,seq(min(year),max(year)))) %>%
          mutate(cosMonth=cos(monthNum*2*pi/12)) %>%
          mutate(sinMonth=sin(monthNum*2*pi/12)) %>%
# log(intake)
          mutate(logintake=log(intake)) %>%
          mutate(logintakems=log(intakems))
          
```

## Scale and center covariates
```{r standardize}
intake$ageYears <- scale(intake$ageYears)[,1]   # scale ageYears
intake$ageMonths <- scale(intake$ageMonths)[,1] # scale ageMonths
intake$yearNum <- scale(intake$yearNum)[,1]     # scale yearNum
intake$mass <- scale(intake$mass)[,1]           # scale mass

# center categorical variables
intake$year <- as.factor(intake$year)
tmp <- unique((cbind(intake$year,apply(model.matrix(~year,intake),2,function(x) scale(x,scale=FALSE)))[,-2]))
tmp <- tmp[order(tmp[,1]),-1]
colnames(tmp) <- gsub("year","",colnames(tmp))
contrasts(intake$year) <- contr.sum(nlevels(as.factor(intake$year)))

# make adult reference
intake$ageClass <- factor(intake$ageClass) # remove pup level
intake$ageClass <- relevel(intake$ageClass,"adult")
tmp <- unique((cbind(intake$ageClass,apply(model.matrix(~ageClass,intake),2,function(x) scale(x,scale=FALSE)))[,-2]))
tmp <- tmp[order(tmp[,1]),-1,drop=FALSE]
colnames(tmp) <- levels(intake$ageClass)[-1]
contrasts(intake$ageClass) <- tmp

# make Sura (F) reference
intake$seal <- relevel(intake$seal,"Sura")
tmp <- unique((cbind(intake$seal,apply(model.matrix(~seal,intake),2,function(x) scale(x,scale=FALSE)))[,-2]))
tmp <- tmp[order(tmp[,1]),-1,drop=FALSE]
colnames(tmp) <- levels(intake$seal)[-1]
contrasts(intake$seal) <- tmp

tmp <- unique((cbind(intake$sex,apply(model.matrix(~sex,intake),2,function(x) scale(x,scale=FALSE)))[,-2]))
tmp <- tmp[order(tmp[,1]),-1,drop=FALSE]
colnames(tmp) <- c("F")
contrasts(intake$sex) <-  tmp

intake$season <- relevel(intake$season,"summer")
tmp <- unique((cbind(intake$season,apply(model.matrix(~season,intake),2,function(x) scale(x,scale=FALSE)))[,-2]))
tmp <- tmp[order(tmp[,1]),-1,drop=FALSE]
colnames(tmp) <- c("winter")
contrasts(intake$season) <-  tmp

intake$facility <- droplevels(intake$facility)
tmp <- unique((cbind(intake$facility,apply(model.matrix(~facility,intake),2,function(x) scale(x,scale=FALSE)))[,-2]))
tmp <- tmp[order(tmp[,1]),-1,drop=FALSE]
colnames(tmp) <- c("LML")
contrasts(intake$facility) <-  tmp
```

```{r data summary}
summary(intake)
```

## Fit models
```{r fit,message=FALSE}
options(width = 300)
library(mgcv)
library(MuMIn)

# fit most general model (oversaturated but establishes all potential covariates in candidate model set)
modgam <- gam(formula = intakems ~
                         seal +
                         yearNum +
                         sex +
                         ageClass*season*sex +
                         ageClass*cos(monthNum*2*pi/12)*sex + ageClass*sex*sin(monthNum*2*pi/12) +
                         s(seal, bs = "re") +
                         s(yearNum),
              family=gaussian(link="log"),
              data = intake, na.action = "na.fail")

# fit all combinations
allcombs <- dredge(modgam,trace=0, subset = 
      !(`cos(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)` && season) &&
      !(`sin(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)` && season) &&
      !(`s(seal, bs = "re")` && seal) &&
      !(`s(seal, bs = "re")` && sex) &&
      !(seal && sex) &&
      !(yearNum && `s(yearNum)`) &&
      dc(`cos(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`,`sin(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`) &&
      dc(`sin(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`,`cos(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`) &&
      dc(`ageClass:cos(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`,`ageClass:sin(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`) &&
      dc(`ageClass:sin(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`,`ageClass:cos(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`) &&
      dc(`cos(monthNum * 2 * pi/12):sex`,`sex:sin(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`) &&
      dc(`sex:sin(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`,`cos(monthNum * 2 * pi/12):sex`) && 
      dc(`ageClass:cos(monthNum * 2 * pi/12):sex`,`ageClass:sex:sin(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`) &&
      dc(`ageClass:sex:sin(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)`,`ageClass:cos(monthNum * 2 * pi/12):sex`)
      )

# minimum AIC model
bestmod <- get.models(allcombs, subset = 1)[[1]]
```

## Results
```{r results,fig.dim = c(15, 10)}
options(width = 300)
summary(bestmod)
plot(bestmod)

talpha <- qt(0.975,df=bestmod$df.null)

new_data <- tidyr::expand(intake, sex, ageClass, monthNum, yearNum,pi=pi)

m_pred <- bind_cols(new_data,
                      as.data.frame(predict(bestmod, newdata = new_data, se.fit = TRUE, type="response")))
m_pred$yearNum <- factor(unique(intake$year)[match(m_pred$yearNum,unique(m_pred$yearNum))])
m_pred <- m_pred %>% mutate(ageClass = fct_relevel(ageClass, c("yearling","juvenile","adult")))

ggplot(m_pred, aes(x = monthNum, y = fit, ymax=fit+talpha*se.fit,ymin=fit-talpha*se.fit,colour = yearNum)) +
  geom_line(aes(group=yearNum)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = 0:11, 
  labels = month.abb) +
  facet_wrap(~ sex + ageClass,ncol=3) +
  ylab("Mass-specific intake (kcal/kg/day)") + xlab("month") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "year")) +
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_color_manual(values = gray.colors(14,start=0,end=0.6))

# model selection and averaging
options(width = 100)
ma <- model.avg(allcombs)
sw(allcombs)

masum<-summary(ma)
mStable <- masum$msTable[which(masum$msTable$weight>0.005),]
termCodes <- attr(mStable,"term.codes")
names(termCodes) <- gsub("s(seal, bs = \"re\")","sealRE",names(termCodes),fixed=TRUE)
names(termCodes) <- gsub("cos(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)","cosMonth",names(termCodes),fixed=TRUE)
names(termCodes) <- gsub("sin(monthNum * 2 * pi/12)","sinMonth",names(termCodes),fixed=TRUE)
round(mStable,2)
paste0(paste0(termCodes,"=",names(termCodes)),collapse=", ")

#masum$coefmat.subset (model-averaged coefficients)
#confint(ma) (model-averaged confidence intervals)

# best supported model with ageClass, season, random individual-level, and year effects
bestmodred <- get.models(allcombs,subset=is.na(sex) & is.na(seal))[[1]]
summary(bestmodred)
plot(bestmodred)

talphared <- qt(0.975,df=bestmodred$df.null)

new_datared <- tidyr::expand(intake, ageClass, yearNum,monthNum,seal,pi=pi)

# effects to exclude
exclude <- c("s(seal)","s(yearNum)")

mred_pred <- bind_cols(new_datared,
                      as.data.frame(predict(bestmodred, newdata = new_datared, se.fit = TRUE, exclude=exclude, type="response")))
mred_pred <- mred_pred %>% mutate(ageClass = fct_relevel(ageClass, c("yearling","juvenile","adult")))

# remove duplicates as seal and yearNum are being excluded
mred_pred <- mred_pred %>% filter(seal==seal[1],yearNum==yearNum[1]) %>% arrange(ageClass)

mred_pred$month <- month(mred_pred$monthNum+1,label=TRUE)

mred_pred$lci <- mred_pred$fit-talphared*mred_pred$se.fit
mred_pred$uci <- mred_pred$fit+talphared*mred_pred$se.fit

mred_pred %>% select(-seal,-yearNum)

ggplot(mred_pred, aes(x = monthNum, y = fit,  colour = ageClass)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(month.name)-1, 
    labels = substr(month.name,1,3)
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group=ageClass)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lci, ymax = uci), alpha=0.3, fill=c("blue","orange","red")[match(mred_pred$ageClass,c("yearling","juvenile","adult"))]) + 
  ylab("mass-specific intake (kcal/kg/day)") + xlab("month") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "age class",override.aes=list(fill=NA))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue","orange","red"))

mred_pred_table = as.data.frame(mred_pred)
mred_pred_table = mred_pred_table[,-which(colnames(mred_pred) %in% c("yearNum","seal"))]
write.csv(mred_pred_table,file="kcal_per_kg_preds.csv")

mred_predlog <- bind_cols(new_datared,
                      as.data.frame(predict(bestmodred, newdata = new_datared, se.fit = TRUE, exclude=exclude)))
mred_predlog <- mred_predlog %>% mutate(ageClass = fct_relevel(ageClass, c("yearling","juvenile","adult")))

# remove duplicates as seal and yearNum are being excluded
mred_predlog <- mred_predlog %>% filter(seal==seal[1],yearNum==yearNum[1]) %>% arrange(ageClass)

mred_predlog$month <- month(mred_predlog$monthNum+1,label=TRUE)

mred_predlog$lci <- mred_predlog$fit-talphared*mred_predlog$se.fit
mred_predlog$uci <- mred_predlog$fit+talphared*mred_predlog$se.fit

mred_predlog %>% select(-seal,-yearNum)

ggplot(mred_predlog, aes(x = monthNum, y = fit,  colour = ageClass)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(month.name)-1, 
    labels = substr(month.name,1,3)
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(group=ageClass)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lci, ymax = uci), alpha=0.3, fill=c("blue","orange","red")[match(mred_pred$ageClass,c("yearling","juvenile","adult"))]) + 
  ylab("log(mass-specific intake kcal/kg/day)") + xlab("month") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "age class",override.aes=list(fill=NA))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue","orange","red"))

```

We'll now attempt to generate posterior predictions for energy intake that account for correlation between parameter estimates by (1) using the gam.predict function to generate design matrices specific to different combinations of covariates, and (2) simulating gam parameters from a multivariate normal distribution.  This can be viewed as an empirical Bayes posterior predictive procedure.

```{r preds}
# limit prediction combinations to those omitting seal and year

data_pred <- new_datared
data_pred <- data_pred %>% filter(seal==seal[1],yearNum==yearNum[1]) %>% arrange(ageClass)

X = predict(bestmodred,newdata=data_pred,type="lpmatrix",exclude=c("s(seal)","s(yearNum)"))

Energy_pred_matrix = matrix(0,dim(X)[1],10000)
Betas = rmvn(10000,bestmodred$coefficients,vcov(bestmodred))  
for(i in 1:10000){
  Energy_pred_matrix[,i] = X %*% Betas[i,]
}
Energy_pred_matrix = exp(Energy_pred_matrix)

data_pred$fit = rowMeans(Energy_pred_matrix)
data_pred$lower = apply(Energy_pred_matrix,1,"quantile",0.025)
data_pred$upper = apply(Energy_pred_matrix,1,"quantile",0.975)

Energy_predictions = list("pred_data"=data_pred,"pred_matrix"=Energy_pred_matrix)
save(Energy_predictions,file="../Data/Energy_predictions.RData")

```
